text: Receives error data from applications using Sentry's open-source SDKs
quote: GlitchTip can use Sentry's open source SDKs to receive error data from your application.

text: Aims to be compatible with the Sentry API so tools that work with Sentry also work with GlitchTip
quote: GlitchTip aims to be Sentry API compatible. Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip.

text: Upload JavaScript source maps with the GlitchTip CLI, which injects debug IDs, to get readable stack traces
quote: For JavaScript projects, upload source maps to get readable stack traces. Use the GlitchTip CLI (Beta) to inject debug IDs and upload source maps

text: Upload native debug symbols (dSYM, PDB, ELF) via the CLI
quote: Upload debug symbols for native applications (dSYM, PDB, ELF): glitchtip-cli debug-files upload ./build --org my-org --project my-project

text: Teams make sure the right people are notified when an error is reported in a project
quote: When making a project, you will also need to create a team if you have not already done so. Teams are for making sure the right people get notified when an error is reported.

text: Configure alerts based on error frequency, sent by email to team members or to a webhook URL
quote: Here you can specify when you want to receive alerts based on the frequency of errors. By default, new project alerts send emails to a project's team members, but you can also add a webhook URL

text: Create releases from the command line with glitchtip-cli
quote: glitchtip-cli releases new 1.0.0 --org my-org --project my-project

text: Associate commits with a release, with auto-discovery from git
quote: Associate commits with a release (auto-discovers from git)

text: Record deployments of a release to an environment via the CLI
quote: Record deployments for a release: glitchtip-cli deploys new 1.0.0 --env production --org my-org --project my-project

text: Log in to a GlitchTip instance from the official CLI
quote: Log in to your GlitchTip instance: glitchtip-cli --url https://your-glitchtip.example.com login

text: Send a test event from the CLI to verify setup
quote: Send a test event to verify your setup: glitchtip-cli send-event -m "Test event from CLI"

text: CLI is configured through environment variables or a local rc file, including Sentry-compatible .sentryclirc
quote: Environment variables — SENTRY_URL, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_DSN, etc. Local config file — .glitchtip-cli.rc or .sentryclirc

text: Performance monitoring that works out of the box to find the slowest web requests, database calls and transactions
quote: GlitchTip takes a simple, works out of the box approach. No dashboard building and metrics hunting. Just find your slowest web requests, database calls, and other transactions.

text: Control the share of transactions sent as performance events with a configurable sample rate
quote: Set this to a low number like 0.01 to have your SDK send only 1 percent of transactions to GlitchTip as performance events.

text: Detect N+1 query patterns across transactions
quote: detect_n_plus_one — Detect N+1 query patterns across transactions (requires DuckDB)

text: Uptime monitoring that pings your site and alerts by email or webhook when it stops responding
quote: GlitchTip can ping your site and warn you when it's not responding. ... If GlitchTip doesn't receive your ping, it will send you an alert via email or webhook.

text: Heartbeat monitoring where your app sends GlitchTip a request on a schedule
quote: GlitchTip can ping your site and warn you when it's not responding. Or reverse it and send GlitchTip a request on schedule.

text: Uptime monitoring of ports
quote: GlitchTip 3.3.0: Feedback survey, uptime port monitoring, issue fingerprint grouping

text: Search and filter application logs alongside errors and performance data
quote: Search and filter your application logs alongside your errors and performance data. Keep everything in one place for faster debugging.

text: Built-in MCP server lets AI assistants access error, performance and log data with no data sharing
quote: GlitchTip includes a built-in MCP server that allows AI assistants to interact with your error tracking, performance, and log data.

text: Through the MCP server, agents can browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues
quote: Investigate errors — Browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues

text: MCP tool to resolve, unresolve or ignore an issue
quote: update_issue — Resolve, unresolve, or ignore an issue

text: MCP tool to search log events by level, service, environment, trace ID or text
quote: list_logs — Search log events by level, service, environment, trace ID, or text query

text: Errors sent by your app are recorded as issues with details, and you are notified
quote: Your web app can send any errors it encounters to GlitchTip, which will notify you and record the error as an issue so you can see the details.

text: Collects exceptions, log messages and Content Security Policy violations in one place
quote: Report your website or application's exceptions, log messages, Content Security Policy violations, and more to one place to triage and resolve.

text: Merge issues together
quote: Merge issue support, hosted servers on US and EU regions, breaking changes.

text: Group issues by fingerprint
quote: GlitchTip 3.3.0: Feedback survey, uptime port monitoring, issue fingerprint grouping

text: Supports OpenTelemetry (OTel)
quote: Deeper reporting, OTel support and plenty of QoL.

text: Supports minidump crash reports
quote: Logs, cold storage, MCP and minidump support

text: Offers cold storage for data
quote: Logs, cold storage, MCP and minidump support

text: Works with GitLab's error tracking feature as a Sentry-type backend
quote: In GitLab, navigate to a project's Settings > Monitor > Error Tracking. Click to enable tracking. Select "Sentry" and enter the GlitchTip URL

text: Can be added as a Sentry data source in Grafana so you can explore GlitchTip data there
quote: Click "Save & Test". Now you should be able to explore your GlitchTip data in Grafana.

text: Supports dark mode
quote: GlitchTip 3.4.0 adds initial support for dark mode

text: Supports SSO login
quote: GlitchTip 3.4.0 adds initial support for dark mode, includes potential breaking changes for SSO

text: Create as many organizations as you need
quote: As you continue with GlitchTip, you will be able to make as many organizations as you need.

text: Use separate projects for different parts of an app or for staging and production
quote: you might choose to set up separate projects for different parts of your app, for example, or to make separate projects for your staging and production instances.

text: Hosted service has a fully independent EU instance in Frankfurt for data residency, plus a US region
quote: For organizations with data residency requirements, GlitchTip offers a fully independent EU instance hosted in Frankfurt, Germany

text: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) available on request
quote: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) available upon request

text: Hosted users can delete all their data by deleting their organization and user
quote: Hosted GlitchTip users have full control over their data and can delete it all when they delete their organization and user.

text: On-demand billing with a monthly spend cap keeps collecting events during spikes
quote: Turn on on-demand billing and set a monthly spend cap. When a spike pushes you past your plan, we keep collecting events and bill only for the extra.

text: Free plan with up to 1,000 events per month
quote: Our Free plan is free forever with up to 1,000 events per month. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time.

text: Open source code you can view, modify and use, either self-hosted or hosted by GlitchTip
quote: It's also open source, so you can view, modify, and use the code as you see fit. Run it on your server, or let us host it for you.

text: Self-host with Docker or Docker Compose, or through one-click hosts like PikaPods and Railway
quote: GlitchTip can be run with Docker. We recommend Docker Compose, PikaPods, Elestio, Nodion, Railway, or RepoCloud.

text: A Helm chart is available for deploying on Kubernetes
quote: GlitchTip can be run with Docker. We recommend Docker Compose... A Helm chart is available for Kubernetes.

text: Needs only PostgreSQL and a single service to run; Valkey/Redis is optional
quote: GlitchTip requires PostgreSQL (14+) and a single service (or separate web and worker services for scaling). Valkey (or redis) 7+ is optional.

text: Database migrations run automatically when upgrading
quote: Pull latest docker image `docker compose pull`... Database migrations will automatically happen.
